- document:
  - text: Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon. $1M in prizes.
  - link "Apply Now":
    - /url: https://cerebralvalley.ai/e/meta-ai-developer-hackathon
  - navigation "Marketing navigation":
    - link "Meta home":
      - /url: /
      - img "Meta"
    - link "Documentation":
      - /url: /docs
    - button "Products"
    - button "Models"
    - button "Resources"
    - button "Community"

      - text: Contact Sales

      - /url: /api/auth/login
      - text: Login
      - status
  - link "Skip to content":
    - /url: "#astryx-app-shell-main"
  - main:
    - heading "Your next build starts with Muse." [level=1]
    - paragraph: Muse Wonder, now on Meta Model API and Muse Code. Muse Wonder Full, now on Muse Code.
    - link "Start building":
      - /url: /api/auth/login
      - text: Start building
      - status
    - link "Contact sales":
      - /url: /contact-sales?referrer_path=%2F
      - text: Contact sales
      - status
    - heading "Muse Code" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Multi-agent coding in your terminal. Built for Muse models.
    - radiogroup "Operating system":
      - radio "Mac" [checked]
      - radio "Windows"
    - code: curl -fsSL https://dev.meta.ai/install.sh | bash
    - button "Copy install command":
      - status
    - heading "Recent models" [level=2]
    - button "Show previous models" [disabled]:
      - status
    - button "Show more models":
      - status
    - region "Available models":
      - group "Model 1 of 9":
        - link "Sign in to open the chat playground":
          - /url: /api/auth/login?next=%2Fplayground%3Fmodel_id%3Dmuse-wonder-1.0
        - heading "Muse Wonder" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Frontier coding, long-running agents, and advanced computer use. Plans long tasks and delegates to sub-agents.
      - group "Model 2 of 9":
        - link "Learn more about Muse Wonder Full (opens in new tab)":
          - /url: https://dev.meta.ai/models/muse-wonder
        - heading "Muse Wonder Full" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Our most advanced model yet, bringing SOTA performance to tackle developers’ most critical workflows.
      - group "Model 3 of 9":
        - link "Sign in to use Muse Spark 1.3 in Playground":
          - /url: /api/auth/login?next=%2Fplayground%3Fmodel_id%3Dmuse-spark-1.3-contributor
        - heading "Muse Spark 1.3" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Built for long-horizon coding and agentic work. Cleaner code, fewer tokens.
      - group "Model 4 of 9":
        - link "Sign in to use SAM 3.1 in Playground":
          - /url: /api/auth/login?next=%2Fplayground%2Fsegmentation%3Fmodel_id%3Dsam-3.1
        - heading "SAM 3.1" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Detect, segment, and track objects from a text prompt, across image and video.
      - group "Model 5 of 9":
        - link "Sign in to use Muse Voice Transcribe in Playground":
          - /url: /api/auth/login?next=%2Fplayground%2Faudio%3Fmodel_id%3Dmuse-voice-transcribe-1.0
        - heading "Muse Voice Transcribe" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Transcribe speech to text with speaker diarization and turn detection.
      - group "Model 6 of 9":
        - link "Sign in to use Muse Image in Playground":
          - /url: /api/auth/login?next=%2Fplayground%2Fimage%3Fmodel_id%3Dmuse-image-1.0
        - heading "Muse Image" [level=3]
        - paragraph: An agentic image model that plans, self-corrects, and refines.
      - group "Model 7 of 9":
        - link "Learn more about Muse Glimmer (opens in new tab)":
          - /url: https://research.meta.ai/blog/introducing-muse-glimmer-open-agentic-model
        - heading "Muse Glimmer" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Built to enable always-on, local agents, available on Hugging Face.
      - group "Model 8 of 9":
        - link "Sign in to use Muse Spark 1.2 in Playground":
          - /url: /api/auth/login?next=%2Fplayground%3Fmodel_id%3Dmuse-spark-1.2
        - heading "Muse Spark 1.2" [level=3]
        - paragraph: A coding-optimized model purpose-built for agentic workflows.
      - group "Model 9 of 9":
        - link "Sign in to use Muse Spark 1.1 in Playground":
          - /url: /api/auth/login?next=%2Fplayground%3Fmodel_id%3Dmuse-spark-1.1
        - heading "Muse Spark 1.1" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Built for agentic workflows, coding, computer use & multimodal perception.
  - heading "Meet Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full" [level=2]
  - navigation "Tabs":
    - button "Marathon planning"
    - button "Game dev"
    - button "Wedding seating"
  - list:
    - listitem:
      - button "Coding at the frontier" [expanded]
      - text: Solve complex engineering tasks in large repositories, making and verifying changes across multiple files in parallel.
    - listitem:
      - button "Long-running agents"
      - text: Hand off multi-step tasks that run for hours, uninterrupted. Muse Wonder plans the work, delegates parts to sub-agents, calls tools in parallel and recovers from errors to keep your critical work on-track.
    - listitem:
      - button "Advanced computer use"
      - text: Power agents that see and operate browsers, desktop, and mobile apps to complete everyday tasks.
    - listitem:
      - button "Active memory"
      - text: Carries important context through conversations and active focus keeps Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full working towards your goals, even when a task gets challenging.
    - listitem:
      - button "Muse Wonder Full"
      - text: Muse Wonder Full is our most advanced model yet and tops agentic and coding benchmarks, including DeepSWE and SWE-Marathon in independent third-party runs.
  - text: GET STARTED
  - heading "More ways to build." [level=3]
  - link "Muse Code Multi-agent coding in your terminal. Built for Muse Wonder and Muse Spark. Start building":
    - /url: /products/muse-code/
    - text: Muse Code Multi-agent coding in your terminal. Built for Muse Wonder and Muse Spark. Start building
    - img
  - link "Meta Model API Direct, self-serve and affordable access to Muse models. Start building":
    - /url: /products/meta-model-api/
    - text: Meta Model API Direct, self-serve and affordable access to Muse models. Start building
    - img
  - link "OpenRouter Swap Muse models into your existing tools and workflows. Start building":
    - /url: https://openrouter.ai/meta/muse-spark-1.2/
    - img
    - text: OpenRouter Swap Muse models into your existing tools and workflows. Start building
    - img
  - heading "Cookbooks and quickstarts" [level=2]
  - link "Read documentation":
    - /url: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/
    - text: Read documentation
    - status
  - link "Quick start Your first working request in under five minutes. Point your existing OpenAI SDK compatible client at Meta Model API. Learn more":
    - /url: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/cookbook#api-fundamentals
    - text: Quick start Your first working request in under five minutes. Point your existing OpenAI SDK compatible client at Meta Model API. Learn more
    - img
  - link "Multi-agent orchestration Stand up a four profile agentic team that turns a one line product idea into a working SaaS app. Learn more":
    - /url: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/cookbook/multi-agent-orchestration
    - text: Multi-agent orchestration Stand up a four profile agentic team that turns a one line product idea into a working SaaS app. Learn more
    - img
  - link "Agent fan-out Spin multiple subagents into isolated worktrees to tackle parallel work without mid-flight collisions. Learn more":
    - /url: http://dev.meta.ai/docs/cookbook/subagent-fanout
    - text: Agent fan-out Spin multiple subagents into isolated worktrees to tackle parallel work without mid-flight collisions. Learn more
    - img
  - link "Computer use Give Muse Wonder eyes and a pair of hands and it can build software the way you do. Learn more":
    - /url: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/cookbook/computer-use
    - text: Computer use Give Muse Wonder eyes and a pair of hands and it can build software the way you do. Learn more
    - img
  - link "GitHub agent Build an autonomous GitHub bot on Meta Model API with Muse Wonder and OpenCode. Learn more":
    - /url: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/cookbook/github-agent
    - text: GitHub agent Build an autonomous GitHub bot on Meta Model API with Muse Wonder and OpenCode. Learn more
    - img
  - link "Search grounding Give your model live access to the web. Add a single tool to your request to get real time information. Learn more":
    - /url: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/cookbook/search-grounding
    - text: Search grounding Give your model live access to the web. Add a single tool to your request to get real time information. Learn more
    - img

  - text: "Muse Code Muse Code: New plans and features Muse Code is now out of beta with new features and updates designed to help you work faster and smarter."
  - link "Read more":
    - /url: /resources/blog/muse-code-new-plans-and-features
  - text: "Meta Model API Muse Image: generate, edit, and compose images on Meta Model API Muse Image is now on Meta Model API at $0.01/image. A reasoning model that plans layout before drawing, with anchored composition for consistent edits."
  - link "Read more":

  - text: "Meta Model API Muse Glimmer: an open-weight model built for local agents | AI Developers blog An agent that manages your schedule, drafts your replies and organizes your files needs deep access to your context."
  - link "Read more":
    - /url: /resources/blog/build-with-muse-glimmer

limitations: Event sequence records provider receipt order; simultaneous browser causality is not inferred.
Network content is retained only when selected; response bytes are browser-decoded, not compressed wire bytes.
Request bytes are limited to what Playwright exposes; not_exposed does not establish body absence or multipart file coverage.
Network content reads settle within 5 seconds each and never wait for unfinished responses or refetch them.
Playwright scenario events do not expose request initiator stacks; receipt order does not prove causality.
Storage values are hashed only after declared-secret redaction.
